summary: Attractor reconstruction reveals global albedo lives on a VERY LOW-DIMENSIONAL manifold: correlation dimension 1.86 (essentially 2D), embedding dimension only 3 (FNN drops from 91% to 2% by dim=3). This strongly supports H002 — the dynamics are highly constrained, consistent with invariant physical properties limiting the degrees of freedom. The Lyapunov exponent is near-zero (+0.0031), indicating marginal stability rather than true chaos. NH has exceptionally high RQA determinism (0.730), suggesting strong deterministic structure. The system is not freely evolving in high-dimensional space but constrained to a low-dimensional manifold by invariant properties.
